name: manual_a8e335
claim: Do not import fcntl at module top in scripts that must run on Windows, and give test modules unique basenames across test directories.

decisions.notes: Collection of the full suite failed on the fcntl import and on two test_lm_link_watch modules sharing one name; msvcrt.locking is the portable fallback.
